notes.title: Game Update 1.1.0 - Bug fixes and improvements
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]
We have a fresh batch of fixes so you can keep dashing and swinging smoothly. Hope you enjoy it!

[h2]Corrections and Enhancements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Camera Fix:[/b] The camera no longer shakes upon death, providing a smoother experience for the player. The camera now properly adjusts when the player exits the screen, ensuring a more seamless transition.
[*] [b]Visual Adjustments:[/b] Background color intensity in the stages has been fine-tuned to improve the overall aesthetic of the game.
[*] [b]Audio Fix:[/b] Sound effects volume has been adjusted, including the gravity modifier, for a more balanced auditory experience.
[*] [b]Gameplay Enhancement:[/b] Projectiles are now removed upon restarting the stage, preventing undesired situations.
[*] [b]Completion Indicators: [/b]Upon completing a stage, there are now clear indicators showing the world and stage the player has reached.
[*] [b]Visible Durability:[/b] Durability indicators have been added for breakable platforms, providing players with crucial information during gameplay.
[*] [b]Time Correction:[/b] Fixed timing issues in World 3, Secret 1, ensuring consistent gaming experience.
[/list]

[b]We appreciate your ongoing support and feedback! Enjoy playing the updated and improved version of Dash & Swing![/b]

notes.title: DASH & SWING IS OUT!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Exciting news! Dash & Swing is finally here!

We understand your eagerness to dive into the game, and we share that excitement too. It's a huge milestone for us to release Dash & Swing, and we couldn't be happier. This game has opened up incredible opportunities for us, from participating in major festivals to receiving video reviews and even witnessing some impressive speedruns.

Here's what Dash & Swing has to offer:
[list]
[*] Over 70 levels, each with unique mechanics, scenarios, and emotions, providing various ways to conquer each level.
[*] Hidden levels that reward players with special items.
[*] Customize your ball with a range of items and skins to make it uniquely yours.
[*] Dive into different radio stations with various styles, or create your own playlist with your favorite MP3 music.
[*] Compete on the leaderboards and strive for the fastest completion time.
[*] Play the game your way, with options to tailor your experience.
[*] We are deeply grateful for the opportunity to add our creation to the vast world of gaming history, and we genuinely hope you have as much fun playing it as we did making it.
[/list]


If you have any feedback, suggestions, or encounter any bugs, please don't hesitate to contact us at contact@innominatumdigital.com. We'll also be keeping an eye on the Steam threads for any community interactions.

Thank you for your support, and we can't wait for you to enjoy Dash & Swing!
